what: Mika in her Nine-Tailed Flame Empress form, a chibi fox-girl heroine: big red-orange fox ears, very long flowing red hair with gold hair ornaments, amber eyes, ornate white and gold armour with red trim and red gem accents, a layered red and white battle dress, white and gold boots, NINE big fluffy fox tails fanned out behind her in a wide half circle like a halo, each tail cream-white at the base turning orange-red with a flame-shaped red tip, a LONG crescent moon glaive (its haft longer than she is tall) with a huge curved orange-gold flame crescent blade
pose: She stands regal and tall like an empress, holding the crescent moon glaive upright in her right hand beside her with the end of its haft resting on the ground and the huge flame crescent blade high above her shoulder, her left hand resting lightly on her hip, a serene confident smile, all NINE fluffy fox tails fanned out wide behind her like a blazing halo.
idle: a regal idle: her body, face, hands, glaive and boots stay still; the NINE tails keep exactly their fan arrangement, sizes and shapes and only their flame tips ripple, one tail after another, like a slow wave travelling along the fan from the lowest tail on the left, over the top, to the lowest tail on the right, each tip settling back once the wave passes; no tail ever jumps, grows, vanishes or swaps places; each tail keeps its own size and outline and only its tip curls a little. Her head, face, eyes and BOTH fox ears stay exactly as in Image 1 in every frame: the ears never twitch, flatten, fold, tilt or change size.
entrance: her nine-tailed fox-fire summoning. Frame 1: no character yet, only nine small round fox-fire flames floating in a wide arc just above the ground where she will stand. Frame 2: the nine flames streak down to one point on the ground and shoot up as nine long tails of fire unfurling upward in a wide fan. Frame 3: the nine fire tails sweep inward and close around the centre into a tall blazing flame bud. Frame 4: the flame bud starts to open like a nine-petal flower of fire. Frame 5: the petals open wide and she is revealed standing in the centre holding her glaive, her nine tails still made of pure fire. Frame 6: her nine tails turn from fire into her real fluffy tails fanned out behind her, flame tips burning. Frame 7: the last petals of fire curl away at her feet. Frame 8: exactly the resting pose of Image 1, no extra flames. All flames are clean opaque painted shapes with crisp edges, never smoke, glow haze or loose sparks. Keep every part inside its cell with margin.
